description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

As Senior Social Media Manager, you will manage the content planning, creation, curation, story ideation, and direct fan communication for the Hers social handles. You will work with key digital platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, etc., as well as seek out emerging platforms that can help us grow our customer base and brand. In addition to maintaining the health of the existing social channels, the Senior Social Media Manager will also help drive our expansion onto new platforms, such as Reddit and YouTube. Success in this role requires a passion for social media, an aptitude for measurement and performance monitoring, excellent project management skills, a keen eye for compelling and innovative content, and a passion for continuous improvement. Skills in shooting and editing video or illustration and design are a major plus. This role is remote and will report to the Senior Director, Social Media & Content Marketing.

You Will:

  • Manage the day-to-day messaging, monitoring, and moderation of assigned Hers social media channels

  • Track the performance of social media campaigns, content, and overall health of the assigned social handles with regular reporting to the Director of Content and other marketing stakeholders

  • Partner with dedicated Creative resources to build an engaging and dynamic social media presence across channels

  • Work closely with the Art Director of Social Video to create scripts/content that will result in the growth of the Hims & Hers TikTok channels

  • Partner with industry leaders and medical experts to create content for the Hims & Hers social channels

  • Edit copy for the Hers and Hims social media channels, as assigned

  • Drive strategy for Hims & Hers' expansion onto new and emerging social platforms

  • Be the liaison for social channels internally and externally, with paid social teams and social media platforms

  • Continuously update social content calendars and copy logs

  • Partner with our Community Coordinators to help source UGC for the social feeds, as well as specific projects like advertisements, marketing materials, product launches, etc.

  • Work cross-functionally with multiple branches of the company (marketing, paid acquisition, communications, etc) to ensure that we are fulfilling their social needs

  • Manage other social editors and contractors as needed

  • Have a pulse on who our customers are and who they would most likely follow, trust, and buy from in the social space

You Have:

  • 5-7 years of related experience in social media/community management

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Journalism, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, English, Media Studies, or a related field

  • Experience building and sharing brand messaging

  • Experience working with TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Pinterest, etc., and an understanding of their analytics/insights, ideally at a brand or media company.

  • Experience shooting and editing video is a major plus

  • Experience creating illustrated graphics is a major plus

  • Passion for storytelling, listening to what the community has to say, and providing engaging experiences in the social space

  • The ability to work independently on a project.

  • Strong project/time-management skills, and the ability to multitask between a mix of short-term and long-term projects, involving multiple teams

  • Adaptable, quick learner with an eye for detail and impeccable communication skills who can work seamlessly in a highly collaborative environment

  • Equal parts analytical and creative; owning projects from conceptualization to analysis fueled by data-driven decisions with a desire to try whatever is new

  • Strong work ethic, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to continuous improvement

  • Last but not least: a sense of humor, patience, and a positive attitude

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.
